name: Belsmuth II
description: Belsmuth II was a planet in the Belsmuth system of the Outer Rim. It had an Imperial technical university which warlord Zsinj converted into a pilot training academy. To confuse Zsinj as to the location of Han Solo's task force, Rogue Squadron and Nova Squadron assaulted the academy.
lead_paragraphs: Belsmuth II was a planet in the Belsmuth system of the Outer Rim. It had an Imperial technical university which warlord Zsinj converted into a pilot training academy. To confuse Zsinj as to the location of Han Solo's task force, Rogue Squadron and Nova Squadron assaulted the academy.
